overview:
Dr. Scott Snyder is a Professor of Educational Psychology and Research and currently serves as the Associate Dean of Research for the UAB School of Education. As an administrator, his focus is on facilitating the quality and impact of the research of faculty and students within the UAB School of Education. Scott's research spans a variety of disciplines including special education, higher education, quality of life, medical education, exercise science, health promotion, teacher education, and attitudes toward evolution. He is the author or co-author of over 60 professional publications. While he has skills and experience in statistical analyses and research methods, his primary technical expertise is in measurement and program evaluation. He directed the UAB Center for Educational Accountability for 20 years, has served as a technical advisor in measurement and accountability to the Alabama Department of Education for over 20 years, and has conducted or directed over 40 program evaluations at university, community, state and regional levels in a variety of disciplines. His service and evaluation efforts are directed to improving the quality of outcomes for students, patients, and clients across Alabama. 

While Scott has taught 20 different undergraduate or graduate courses during his time at UAB, he currently teaches intermediate and advanced statistics. He has two YouTube channels to extend his impact on statistical literacy. 

Scott holds appointments in several UAB research centers and has a secondary appointment in the UAB School of Engineering.
